objective: Build a disposable reference target core with target-side atomic generation/CAS and durable operation receipts, without contacting an actual production or adopter destination. Live reference deployment remains blocked until explicitly authorized environment and credential are provided.
nonGoals: No running network listeners by default, no deployment to an adopter, VPS, or production service
No claim that local SQLite marker changes prove health, migration, compensation or authenticated remote receipt
No unattended use unless destination policy/credential authorization and recovery are separately qualified
decisions: Use single-database transactional target-side compare-and-swap with monotonic generation, stable operation key and durable outcome.
Treat local reference effect and receipt as a testable authority boundary, not as a production deployment or service-health proof.

obligations.description: Reject stale generation and wrong compare-and-swap expectation even from an otherwise valid caller.
Record durable receipt atomically with target effect, permit same-key replay only for exact same parameters.
No service credentials, migration/compensation or authenticated destination verification; explicitly not real deployment qualified.

structure: src/sf/reference_target.py: independent transactional target-side fence/CAS and receipt
tests/test_reference_target.py: conflicting operations, stale generations, lost reply, restart
docs/factory/evidence/PQ-05.md: local target-only evidence and live blockers
impact: Standalone reference target model; existing fake target and project adapter untouched

budget.network: None for tests; no live target
budget.execution: SQLite fixture checks and normal PR checks only

externalEffects: Only temporary SQLite test files and this repository branch; no release grant use, live service, or external project writes
